description: 14 concurrent /api/chat requests as user1, fired via concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=14), against the rebuilt backend with the new per-user rate limiter (10 req/60s).

results.note: botocore.errorfactory.ThrottlingException from Bedrock itself, unhandled - see phase9-remediation.md's side finding

conclusion: Rate limiter confirmed working under concurrent load (11/14 correctly throttled). The earlier sequential 12-request test (all 200) was a test-design false negative caused by real Bedrock latency naturally spacing sequential requests beyond the 60s window - see phase9-remediation.md.
